scope: 0.1.5 pre-release P0: LAN listening + address plumbing, lost-response challenge recovery, Proof 1 scope

P0_1_lan.problem: nativeServeOnce listened on /ip4/127.0.0.1 only, the pairing card address was not persisted, and manual sync always dialed loopback, so two phones could never connect
P0_1_lan.rust: new JNI entry SyncTransport.nativeServeAddressOnce(seed, address, allowedCsv, handler) built on the same serve_with path (Noise + Ed25519 binding + allow-list); library rebuilt for aarch64-linux-android
P0_1_lan.android: serve listens on /ip4/0.0.0.0/tcp/47960; dial uses sync_cursor.last_address when it is a /ip4/ multiaddr and falls back to loopback otherwise; the address used is written back on success (no more 127.0.0.1 overwrite); the pairing card now carries the local site-local IPv4 and a pasted address is persisted with the pairing
P0_1_lan.build_note: the documented build command failed on this machine because the Homebrew rustc shadows the rustup one; docs/sync_android_build.md now pins RUSTC=$HOME/.cargo/bin/rustc
P0_1_lan.verification: library rebuilt (alignment still 0x4000 for all four LOAD segments), symbol present, APK built and installed

P0_2_recovery.problem: the responder persisted its new challenge before the response could be delivered; a lost response left the requester on the old challenge and every retry failed with challenge_mismatch
P0_2_recovery.design: keep the last three issued challenges (schema 20 previous_challenges); a request echoing a historical challenge is accepted in recovery mode, which re-issues the current challenge without advancing; unknown challenges still fail closed
P0_2_recovery.why_not_reset: resetting the chain on mismatch would reopen the replay window the previous round closed
P0_2_recovery.idempotence: a retry re-applies the same records, which the vector-clock/tombstone merge already treats idempotently
P0_2_recovery.tests: new ChallengeChainHostTest + test_challenge_chain: bootstrap, normal advance, recovery accept, recovery must not advance, converged retry advances, unknown challenge rejected

scope.proof1: narrowed to cross-device memory continuity and sync trust; tasks, grants and full audit history are separate proofs
added_fault_steps: address must not be overwritten by 127.0.0.1

verification.device: 0.1.5 installed; schema 19 -> 20 migrated; audit page reports 10 events chain intact; RUN_SUITE 48 / TASK_CENTER 10 / RUN_DOCUMENTS 20 PASS
verification.not_verified: no second phone, so LAN dial/serve, lost-response recovery and the new fault steps have not been executed between two real devices
